data.content: Bodrumi i Vjetër is the most famous winery in Kosovo, which was founded in 1950 as a publicly owned enterprise.
Bodrumi i Vjetër continues to preserve the tradition and produce wines of high geographical genesis in accordance with European standards.
We managed the social networks of Bodrumi i Vjetër, always promoting their products and highlighting the characteristics of the wines through facts and creative posts.
During 2021, the European Union invested in sophisticated machinery, which helped this wine improve in quality.

Bodrumi i Vjetër wanted to make this known to the general public and trusted us to promote this campaign. We took care to communicate this campaign to the general public and promoted these investments in detail.
And in the end, we made a video spot for this investment, in which we combined the images with the words with extraordinary poetics and conveyed the message that needed to be conveyed.
Through each post, we took care to convey the elegance of the wines and this winery.
We also designed the website of Bodrumi i Vjetër, which we made both visually appealing and functional.
